## M5C Gate A final attestation — github:QUHONGYE-gif

我以 GitHub 身份 QUHONGYE-gif、作为 scientific authority 与 approving collaborator，独立审核 PR #103 finalization candidate HEAD e3b3c75690330f3ae7b83d9b7a2ddc7b186dc356 / tree 54ba3051cbb31f2bfa36b752f2db7ab96ffde1a4，并确认我此前的 pre-final 决定 comment 5566572994 未撤销或漂移。我也审核 Mika 对 revision 6 exact HEAD 1542008c043cc5bbdc1fc9e30ca9188f1b0f29fa 的 findings-focused PASS；本 finalization commit 没有改变 scientific contract 或 passing preflight evidence。

我对 contract m5c-proteingym-prospective-v1 version 6、scientific-contract digest abc16ed38664d63efede535de3ecd8b8552031e52b156c37023e7b7e717d5278、decision gate-a-m5c-proteingym-v6、final decision digest 2d7b6e869a56e364383e3f84ba4496a95e239a7766743af24cb3e3f8a1d7a7f0 作出最终 AUTHORIZED attestation。

PCDB-GOVERNANCE-DECISION-SHA256: 2d7b6e869a56e364383e3f84ba4496a95e239a7766743af24cb3e3f8a1d7a7f0

我明确批准同一 Gate 内的全部四项 major boundaries：

- held_out_boundary：批准合同的 truth-last、capability separation 和 candidate-level non-disclosure；只允许正式 evaluator/oracle 在有效 Gate、Run identity 和 preflight 全部通过后按合同访问 DMS truth，禁止 surrogate/acquisition/reporting 或 reviewer 获取未揭示 truth、held-out、高价值 membership/identity。
- primary_endpoint：批准合同冻结的 assay-level branch recall、primary E-G / E-M contrasts、H_0.01、truth-boundary tie 规则、40 paired states、20,000-draw shared-seed-slot bootstrap、99.375% intervals、taxonomy/heterogeneity precedence；seed、branch 和 replicate 都不是独立 assay。
- dataset_inclusion：批准完整四 assay cohort BLAT_ECOLX_Firnberg_2014、CAPSD_AAV2S_Sinai_2021、GFP_AEQVI_Sarkisyan_2016、SPG1_STRSG_Olson_2014，以及仅在任何 prohibited outcome access 前依据冻结 eligibility failure 且保留失败证据的 exclusion；批准 ESM1v_single -> esm1v_t33_650M_UR90S_1 alias、direction +1，ESM1v_ensemble 不替代 single-seed baseline。
- cost_semantics：批准一个 sealed formal slice、32/64 initial observations 加一个 16-label batch、静态公开 proxy 的零 label cost，以及合同定义的 disjoint cumulative caps、stop/expiry 和最多两次 main attempts；不批准多轮或结果驱动追加。

我确认并批准以下操作与资源边界：

1. 已完成 summary-only preflight 是历史一次性动作：attempt m5c-summary-preflight-20260907T071812Z、零重试、91,898 content bytes、保守上界 180 wall s / 10 CPU s / 256 MiB RSS / 1 MiB scratch / 1 MiB read-network / 0 CNY；它已在原截止时间前随首次 passing result 结束，不恢复、不重置、不延期。
2. 仅在双方 final attestation 已认证且 production contract Check 通过后，批准 github:willzhang/server:siyuan 在 protein-6000（kernel hostname ps）进行必要 namespace provisioning 和 accepted 45-object prefix 的 byte-only staging；service:pcdb-runner 运行一个 sealed M5C formal slice。main 累计上限为 24 h wall、384 CPU h、48 GB RSS、30 GiB scratch、4 GiB staging/network、100 CNY、最多 2 attempts、零 ordinary-run COS writes、无新付费资源。首个 protected side effect/truth read 前必须生成 post-Gate Run identity，绑定实际 clean reviewed commit/tree/environment、authorized contract 和 passing input/capability-manifest digest。任一 namespace/ACL/backup/RPO/source/environment/input/capacity/cap 检查失败即停止。该权限最迟在有效 Gate A 后 14 天、首个有效 main terminal、额度耗尽、撤销或 identity/boundary drift 时结束，以最早者为准。
3. 首个有效 main terminal 后，批准一次同主机 capability-limited aggregate-only Mika reproduction：1 h wall、2 CPU h、4 GB RSS、2 GiB scratch、1 GiB network、5 CNY；只重算 hashes、20,000-draw intervals、taxonomy 和 cohort roll-up，禁止 candidate-level truth/membership/identity、model fitting、acquisition 或第二个科学结果；首次有效复现或 7 天后结束。
4. 仅在有效 Gate B 后，批准 service:pcdb-archiver 向新的 digest-keyed M5C prefix 发布 compact terminal archive：最多 128 个非 marker 对象、1 GiB archive、1 GiB network、2 h wall、4 CPU h、4 GB RSS、2 GiB scratch、10 CNY；禁止 overwrite/delete，逐对象 fresh readback，_SUCCESS 最后写；成功 archive 或 7 天后结束。

preflight/main/reproduction/archive 四个费用桶互不借用，里程碑总上限 120 CNY。仍不批准：production Gate Check 通过前启动 Stage 2、恢复旧 preflight、raw-score 数据行或越界 truth/held-out 读取、M5D/M6、多轮、pool-external truth、新付费资源、原始数据公开、候选级 reviewer 访问、Gate B 前 evidence promotion。

这是我针对上述 final decision digest 的最终 authenticated attestation；单独一条评论不使 Gate A 生效。只有另一 authority 也独立发布同一 marker、两份评论被 fresh-read 并准确绑定、manifest_status 改为 authorized 且 production contract Check 通过后，Gate A 才生效。

rationale: Final Gate A decision payload prepared after Mika's revision 6 findings-focused PASS. It preserves the exact-bound v4 artifacts as historical failure evidence and binds the passing v5 replacement input/capability manifest and finite-coverage report. Authenticated GitHub comments 5566509712 and 5566572994 ratify the outcome-independent ESM1v_single alias/direction, bind the migration receipt to the accepted Issue #11 terminal inventory, bound the completed summary-only attempt, and conditionally approve main, aggregate-only reproduction and terminal archive resources/operations. The replacement exact-checks all four allowed summary/processing-manifest pairs without opening a raw-score data row or truth file. This final payload does not become an effective Gate A until both authorities publish fresh comments containing its exact marker and all four major boundaries, their authenticated envelopes replace the pending placeholders, manifest_status becomes authorized, and the production contract Check passes.
